nodes.text:
@keanfei47 @POGO333333 @worldinfocus_24 @thinking_panda Sorry to hear that, Alfred

I'm at the "counting weeks" stage - with a very slim chance for a couple of years
Small cell lung carcinoma is always fatal and deferment is all that can be expected
Chinese folklore says that if you make it to 84, you'll go on to 100. Hang in there.
